name: ISV Engagement and enhancements
description: the release of a new tutorial and sample code designed to support ISV Engagement and enhancements based on our Public API. This comprehensive guide provides step-by-step instructions and practical examples to help you integrate and leverage our API effectively. Whether you're looking to enhance your existing applications or develop new solutions, this tutorial and sample code will provide the necessary tools and insights to get you started quickly and efficiently.Try our latest GitHub repository that demonstrates an end-to-end Fabric real-time Intelligence (RTI) solution using Microsoft Fabric Public APIs. This demo allows you to ingest, transform, analyze, and act on real-time data, all within minutes! You can either clone this repo or download the notebook file located in the "Deployment Notebook" folder. https://lnkd.in/dsFTbn8a
